entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I bought these expensive cycling shoes from you about a month ago and they're complete garbage. I want my money back, now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Are you serious? It's not a 'preference' to have my feet shredded! They're giving me horrible blisters on every ride. On top of that, the cleats keep shifting no matter how hard I tighten them. I'm not going to sit here and troubleshoot your defective product, I want a refund!

I understand your frustration completely, and I apologize for the discomfort the shoes have caused. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility. Can you confirm the order number or the email address used for the purchase?

It's under john.doe@email.com. And you better not give me some runaround about it being 30 days. This is unacceptable! If I don't get a resolution on this call, I'm putting VeloFit on blast all over my cycling club's forum and filing a chargeback. Get me a manager!

There's no need for that, sir, I can absolutely handle this for you. I see the order here. You received the cycling shoes 32 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can process a full return and refund for you right now.
Wait, really? You're just... going to do it? No more questions?

That's correct. I apologize again for the trouble with the blisters and the loose cleats. I've just initiated the return in our system. I am sending a pre-paid return shipping label to your email now. Simply pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop it at any shipping center. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Huh. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted. Make sure that label actually shows up.
It has just been sent, you should see it within the next few minutes. Will there be anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
